2026
 Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Jbp:18048
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajendra Kumar Vani

On The 6 th Of March, 2026
 Criminal Appeal No. 984 of 2026
 Avadhesh Kori
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Brahmendra Prasad Pathak - Advocate for the appellant
 Shri Mukesh Shukla - Government Advocate for the responden
 Order

The appellant has filed this first criminal appeal under Section 14-A of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 being aggrieved by order dated 20.01.2025 passed in Bail Application No.25/2026 passed by the Special Judge under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, Singrauli, MP whereby his bail application filed under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023, has been rejected.

2 . The appellant has been arrested on 31.12.2025 relating to FIR/Crime No.128/2025 registered at police station - Chitrangi, District Singrauli (M.P.); for offence punishable under Sections 376(1),
376(2)(N) of IPC, Section 69, 351(3) of BNS, 2023 and Sections 3(2)(va), 3(2)(v) and 3(2)(w)(i) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the present appellant that the present appellant is in custody since 31.12.2025.
The charge sheet has NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:18048 2 CRA-984-2026 already been filed.
It is further submitted that the present appellant has been implicated falsely in this case.
As per the story of prosecution, the physical relationship between the present appellant and prosecutrix took place on 22.10.2022 on the false promise of marriage.
It is also submitted that the FIR has been lodged not before 08.11.2025.

Though DNA report in respect of child is positive and his biological father is present appellant but since the relationship was consensual, therefore, no offence is made out against the present appellant.
It is also submitted that the prosecutrix and present appellant both are major.
The appellant has no criminal antecedents.
He is ready to comply with the conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
Therefore, it is prayed that the appellant may be granted benefit of bail.

sentences.text: 4 . Per contra, learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application/appeal and prayed for its rejection.
5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6 . Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and the entire facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is inclined to release the present appellant on bail.

Thus, without commenting on the merits of the case, the appeal is allowed and it is directed that appellant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.70,000/- (Rupees Seventy Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court/Committal Court.
8 . Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
